name: Salary Slip-pay_payroll_run
label: Payroll Run
description: The Logistay Payroll Run that built this slip.

name: Salary Slip-pay_payable_line
label: Payable Line
description: P-190 Payable Line that is the GROSS provenance for this slip; never hand-keyed.

name: Salary Slip-pay_rec_run
label: Reconciliation Run
description: Denormalized P-190 run reference for audit.

name: Salary Slip-pay_partial_reason
label: Partial Reason
description: Carried through from the P-190 Payable Line; a partial pay is never silent.

name: Salary Slip-pay_consent_complete
label: Consent Complete
description: 1 = every deduction on this slip carries a verified consent; else the slip is held.

name: Salary Slip-pay_net_negative
label: Net Negative
description: 1 = deductions exceeded gross; the excess is capped/deferred (recoverable at exit). WPS net never goes below zero.

name: Salary Slip-pay_wps_included
label: WPS Included
description: 0 if the worker bank/IBAN detail was rejected; such a slip is excluded from the WPS file and logged.

name: Additional Salary-pay_category
label: Deduction Category
options:
Vehicle Insurance Excess
Vehicle Damages
Traffic Fine
COD Shortage
Missing Shipments Cash
Custody Shortfall
Loan Balance Offset
Iqama Renewal Recharge
Late 30min Penalty
Days Under 20 Adjustment
Success Percent Penalty
Departure Late Penalty
description: P-192 deduction taxonomy: 1-8 operational liability, 9-12 performance. Iqama Renewal Recharge is held pending the D9 legality decision. Present only on deductions raised through the Logistay payroll gate.

name: Additional Salary-pay_source
label: Deduction Source
description: Whether this deduction came from a P-190 performance candidate or an operational-liability event.

name: Additional Salary-pay_candidate
label: Deduction Candidate
description: P-190 Deduction Candidate this deduction realizes (performance source).

name: Additional Salary-pay_consent
label: Deduction Consent
description: The verified Deduction Consent (reused Employee Deduction Acknowledgment) that authorizes this deduction. MANDATORY for any Deduction. The payroll gate additionally requires it to be approved, in-window, within cap, and not a held category.

name: Additional Salary-pay_payroll_run
label: Payroll Run
description: The Logistay Payroll Run this deduction belongs to.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_category
label: Payroll Deduction Category
options:
Vehicle Insurance Excess
Vehicle Damages
Traffic Fine
COD Shortage
Missing Shipments Cash
Custody Shortfall
Loan Balance Offset
Iqama Renewal Recharge
Late 30min Penalty
Days Under 20 Adjustment
Success Percent Penalty
Departure Late Penalty
description: P-192 payroll taxonomy for a Logistay delivery-payroll consent (extends the Habitat damage/rent/fuel/custody deduction_type). Consent category must match the deduction category at apply time.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_consent_scope
label: Consent Scope
description: How broadly this consent authorizes deductions.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_cap_amount
label: Consented Cap Amount
description: The acknowledged amount/cap that bounds what may be withheld. Real value seeded out-of-repo; empty at commit.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_valid_from
label: Consent Valid From
description: Effective-dated: a deduction dated before this is not authorized.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_valid_to
label: Consent Valid To
description: Effective-dated: a deduction dated after this is not authorized.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_obtained_by
label: Consent Obtained By
description: Maker: who captured the worker's consent. Must differ from the verifier.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_verified_by
label: Consent Verified By
description: Checker: who verified the consent. Must differ from who obtained it (maker-checker).

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_candidate
label: Deduction Candidate
description: P-190 performance candidate this consent covers, when applicable.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_payroll_run
label: Payroll Run
description: The Logistay Payroll Run this consent was consumed by.

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment-pay_held
label: Held (Category 8)
description: 1 = an iqama-renewal-recharge consent held closed until the D9 legality decision is seeded. The deduction gate blocks the apply regardless.

name: Salary Deduction Policy-pay_category_8_legal_cleared
label: Iqama-Recharge Deduction Legally Cleared
description: D9 gate. OFF by design (fail-safe): while off, iqama-renewal-recharge (category 8) deductions are held and cannot post. Turn on only after the legality decision is recorded; value seeded out-of-repo.
